chat_history.question: can you tell me about Asia University Vietnam
chat_history.answer:
Asia University Vietnam is a higher education institution established in collaboration with Asia University in Taiwan. It is recognized for its high rankings on global university lists, such as being placed in the TOP 401-500 category by THE in 2025. The university has received approval from the Vietnamese Ministry of Education and Training to operate and has been certified for meeting educational standards in accordance with Resolution No. 03/NQHĐKĐCL.

The degree programs offered by Asia University Vietnam are aligned with the accreditation standards mandated by the Taiwanese government (IEET) and international bodies like AACSB, especially in the fields of business. This ensures that the qualifications are also recognized by the Vietnamese government.
